scope: Offline analysis of already recorded alpha.40 complex trial; no new model calls
counting: Unique tool_use.id in saved events; parent_tool_use_id separates coordinator and delegated calls; tools are not equivalent to model turns
findings: Coordinator separately read Skill, owner contract, workspace guidance, coordination guidance, review guidance, requirements and revision before delegation.
Coordinator read implementation files and oracle sources before assigning two implementation workers despite existing discovery-ownership guidance.
Coordinator also requested general help and worktree-create help after reading workspace guidance.
decision: Do not launch another identical live trial or add another redundant instruction. Existing guidance does not establish reliable avoidance of coordinator pre-reading. Any next candidate must directly address this observed behavior and preserve independent review and integration checks.
limitations: No attribution of tokens or milliseconds to individual tools; counts do not prove causal performance savings.
One synthetic trial, not a representative workload distribution.
No claim that each predelegation call is unnecessary; requirements, authority and workspace checks remain required.
